jobs.description:
Do you possess an IRATA Level 3 certificate, are you technically skilled, and do you enjoy working at heights? Do you enjoy leading and supervising operational teams, with a keen eye for safety and quality, and do you also like to roll up your sleeves? Furthermore, do you have an affinity for technical work and various industries, and are you up for working on the most challenging projects in hard-to-reach locations, such as at height and in confined spaces? Then this position as Rope Access Technician/Supervisor at Sky-Access B.V. is exactly what you are looking for! Company is based in Roosendaal.

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for someone:

• With a valid IRATA level 3 certificate (hard demand)
• Who enjoys being physically active in their work
• Who has an affinity for working safely, the various industries, and technology
• With a flexible and positive work attitude, a team player
• Who has technical insight and enjoys working with their hands
• With a technical background
• With the necessary capabilities and ambition to take responsibility for rope safety on the projects
• Who takes initiative, both solicited and unsolicited, and provides advice on IRATA-related knowledge, skills, and methodologies
• Who is willing to work occasionally at irregular times (weekends/nights)
• With a good command of English
• Who holds a B driving license
• With VCA-VOL certification (or willing to obtain it)

________________________________________

What do we offer you?
• Contract duration: Intention is a permanent contract. First year a fixed term contract of 12 months (will be changed into a permanent contract if skills, performance and work attitude are meeting company demands)
Trial period: 1 month
Salary range (gross/month): €3.500 – €4.000 in accordance with the Collective Labour Agreement for the Small Metal Industry
Housing: Employer offers suitable housing for the first period (to help the foreign colleque) – for this a contribution of the costs are for the account of employee (cost indication: between € 500 and € 600)
• A varied and challenging job within an enthusiastic and close-knit team
• Ample opportunities for personal development (IRATA upgrades, courses, advancement to project manager, IRATA part-time roles)
• Working on unique and technically challenging projects, both nationally and internationally
• Support and guidance in your career and certification processes
• A no-nonsense company culture with a focus on safety and quality

Do you want to work as a chef in the Netherlands this summer?

Do you have a passion for cooking and do you want to further develop your culinary talent in an inspiring environment? Restaurant De Basiliek in Middelburg is looking for a chef to join our team for the months of June, July, August, and September.

What will you be doing?

You will work together in a team with other Spanish colleagues. From mise en place to preparing dishes during service.

Who are you?

- You have at least 1 year of experience in a professional kitchen and work independently
- You speak English
- You have an eye for detail and present dishes with care
- You love challenges
- You work neatly, are stress-resistant, and think in solutions
- You are flexible and a true team player

About us
De Basiliek is located in Middelburg, a historic city close to the sea. De Basiliek is a beloved spot in our city frequented by many locals as well as tourists. We offer a modern menu with a Spanish touch, where shared dining and the grill set us apart. Quality, taste, and experience are our top priorities. As a cook, you are an important part of this experience.

The employee is employed as a seasonal worker. The employment contract is for 6 weeks to 4 months, at least June, July, August, and September. A fixed working volume averaging 38 hours per week is agreed upon. Working hours may vary per week but are averaged over the duration of the employment contract. More hours may be worked in certain weeks as needed.

Salary: The minimum salary is €2,500 gross per month and depends on education and experience. Salary classification is in accordance with the 2025-2026 Hospitality CLA.

Accommodation is available. Costs amount to €650 including energy, Wi-Fi, etc. It concerns the 2nd floor of a house with shared use of:

• the kitchen
• the toilet
• the bathroom
• the balcony
The bedroom does not need to be shared.

jobs.occupation: English-speaking CE truck driver - frozen food transport
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced CE Driver who's living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home most evenings?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

jobs.occupation: Handyman / general facilities technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician with solid electrical knowledge and a passion for maintenance, repairs, and problem-solving? Do you enjoy having variety in your work and being the go-to person for all technical issues? And are you already living in Belgium?

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician or handyman to help maintain the buildings, warehouse facilities, technical installations and outdoor areas. Your role

Your key duties:

• Perform electrical maintenance and repairs
• Carry out minor repairs to plumbing, storage racks, equipment...
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers

Your profile:

• Good knowledge of electrical systems and installations
• Basic knowledge of plumbing, mechanics, building maintenance, or general technical repairs
• Experience as a maintenance technician, handyman, facilities technician, general maintenance worker...
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English

• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)

jobs.occupation: HR and Legal Recruiting Manager - Brussels - Law Firm
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international law firm with headquarters in the United States and a strong global presence across key financial and legal markets. The Brussels office operates within a highly integrated international partnership structure and collaborates closely with teams based in London and other European offices.

The firm is recognised for its excellence in legal advisory services and its client-focused approach. The culture is professional, fast-paced, international, and built around high standards of quality, confidentiality, and collaboration.

The Brussels office currently works closely with international HR, Legal Recruiting & Development, Administration, and Payroll stakeholders, mainly based in London. The environment requires professionalism, adaptability, and the ability to work independently while interacting with senior stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions.

The position offers the opportunity to become a key point of contact for all HR and lawyer recruitment matters in Brussels, with future growth perspectives as the local team evolves.

Jobomschrijving

Lawyer Recruitment & Development

• Manage recruitment processes for Legal Interns, Legal Researchers, Traineeships, and lateral hires
• Coordinate with recruitment agencies and academic institutions, including the College of Europe
• Organise and attend university career fairs and recruitment events
• Coordinate interviews, including logistics, MS Teams scheduling, meeting rooms, reminders, and feedback collection
• Prepare employment offers and obtain internal approvals
• Maintain recruitment databases, trackers, and reporting tools
• Liaise with Brussels bar associations regarding lawyer admissions
• Coordinate pre-employment checks including conflicts, background screening, and relocation support
• Manage onboarding and induction processes in collaboration with London teams
• Deliver onboarding and welcome sessions for new joiners
• Support lawyer training, development, performance reviews, and mid-year review processes
• Coordinate immigration matters with external legal counsel
• Maintain knowledge of the Belgian legal recruitment market

Offboarding

• Manage employee departure processes and offboarding checklists
• Coordinate with HR Operations to ensure proper system and administrative closure

Employee Relations

• Support Directors and senior stakeholders in handling employee relations matters
• Provide guidance on HR policies and their application

HR Administration

• Prepare orientation schedules and onboarding documentation
• Maintain personnel files and HR records
• Draft ad hoc HR correspondence and employment references
• Support senior HR and Administration leadership with administrative tasks
• Assist on HR-related projects and training coordination

• Minimum 5 years of experience in Recruitment and/or HR within Belgium
• Experience within a law firm or professional services environment is strongly preferred
• Bachelor's degree
• Strong knowledge of HR administration and recruitment processes
• Comfortable working in a stand-alone role with autonomy and accountability
• Ability to manage confidential matters with discretion and professionalism
• Strong organisational and multitasking skills
• Calm under pressure and able to operate in a demanding environment
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
• Hands-on, proactive, and customer-oriented mindset
• Strong team player with the ability to collaborate internationally
• Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and HR systems
• Fluent English is mandatory
• French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets
